releaseNotes:
• v1.5.0: Heartbeat Resilience & 1v1 Match Continuity
• 1v1 Disconnect Recovery: Seamlessly reconnect to active matches without losing board progress
• Turn Timer Preservation: Remaining turn countdowns are preserved across pause and reconnect
• Hardened Notifications: Authenticated push notifications with native quick actions and duplicate suppression
• Friends & Audio Polish: Roster loading fix and haptic silencing controls
